summary: Iteration 2 testing complete. Added 11 new pytest cases covering settings (public/get/put/role isolation/persistence), rapor (admin/guru/404), and manual attendance (create/update/role isolation). All 11 new + 44 regression = 55/55 backend tests pass. Frontend smoke via Playwright: admin login shows Cetak Rapor + Pengaturan in sidebar; Settings page loads, edits persist across reload; Rapor page renders class/student selectors + Print button; Attendance Input Manual tab, Rekap Excel button, Ledger Excel/Print buttons all present; Kiosk public page renders camera-video + capture + upload + type selectors with NO keypad (confirmed removed); siswa role isolation holds (/pengaturan and /rapor redirect to /dashboard).
critical_code_review_comments: routes_report.rapor iterates all subjects+assessments per call; for a class-wide rapor batch (all students), that becomes O(N*subjects*assessments). Consider aggregating in one query or memoizing subject list.
routes_settings stores logo as base64 in Mongo document; large images will blow up the settings doc size. Consider a max size guard (e.g., 200 KB) or moving to a file/blob store.
settings.whatsapp_api_key is returned in /api/settings (admin) as plain text. OK for admin-only endpoint but consider masking in list responses if surfaced elsewhere.
routes_attendance.manual_attendance does not validate status against allowed values (hadir/terlambat/izin/sakit/alpa); a bad value will be stored as-is.
